control: Match residual width, depth, FFN, tokenizer, global Q/KV geometry, optimizer family, schedule, document order and initialization seed. Replace KDA positions with full GQA. Report parameter, FLOP and state differences; this estimates architecture packages, not an isolated decay rule.
optimization: R0/R1 independently check a bounded LR neighborhood for both architectures. Freeze a stable shared recipe or named architecture-specific optima before R2. Disclose tuning expense and distinguish shared-recipe from tuned-package conclusions.

systems.optional: CPU only after a working recurrent backend
measurements: training wall time and analytic FLOPs
systems.state_boundary: Periodic exact GQA retains context-growing cache and quadratic global-attention prefill; no constant-memory or fully linear-prefill claim for the complete hybrid.
